title: The End of American Exceptionalism?
description: Liberal democracy is in worldwide retreat, including in its birthplace — the United States.
author: Charles A. Kupchan

title: White House Moves to Take Control of N.I.H. Grants
description: Federal officials are drafting an executive order that would place grants under review by an outside panel, the latest effort to redirect billions of dollars in research spending.
author: Carolyn Y. Johnson, Sheryl Gay Stolberg, Tony Romm and Michael C. Bender

title: There Is Something We Have to Do Right Now About A.I.
description: Letting A.I. patrol its own frontier is like asking Jesse James to patrol the Wild West.
author: Ezra Klein, Marie Cascione, Claire Gordon and Rollin Hu

title: Vance Has a Twisted Idea of What It Means to Be American
description: I am a “heritage American,” too. How should that guide my life?
author: David French

title: Who Gets to Decide A.I.’s Moral Code?
description: A small number of people are shaping what chatbots value. Those choices are already influencing how people think.
author: Lauren Jackson

title: In Fighting for Every Black Child, Did I Betray My Own?
description: A decade ago, I made a decision about my daughter’s education that I hoped would challenge New York City’s separate and unequal school system. Now 16, she thinks I made the wrong choice.
author: Nikole Hannah-Jones

title: Ed Sheeran Addresses War in Gaza After Macklemore Is Dropped From Tour
description: Back onstage, Sheeran acknowledged “mistakes” over the departure of supporting acts, and discussed the “horrific” attack on Israel and the “humanitarian crisis” in Gaza.
author: Ben Sisario

title: Go Ahead and Laugh at Mediums. They May Be On to Something.
description: Research into the benefits of sensing those we’ve lost.
author: Sarah Wildman

title: Annie Dillard Will Live on Forever
description: Annie Dillard died this week. But her voice — wild and holy and hilarious — continues to live in my head, my soul, and somehow, my dog.
author: Sam Anderson

title: Pennsylvania Measles Outbreak Leads to an Increase in Vaccinations
description: As the outbreak grows to more than 700 confirmed cases, the largest in the country, some people remain opposed to vaccines and others are rushing to get the shots.
author: Pooja Salhotra, Mark Bonamo and Kevin Williams

title: In China, A.I. Is Moving Forward While the Economy Lags Behind
description: As Xi Jinping arrives in the United States this week for a state visit, China’s advances in artificial intelligence will be in the air. Less discussed: China’s economy in its worst shape in decades.
author: Li Yuan

title: The Most Handsome Melon in Mexico? Yes, It’s a Real Contest.
description: In the eastern city of Xalapa, what started as a joke among friends over two decades ago has become a vibrant annual tradition that highlights creativity and absurdity with melons.
author: James Wagner and Luis Antonio Rojas

title: Judy Gumbo, Who Found Freedom as a Yippie, Dies at 83
description: She was part of the leftist radical group, which mocked institutional authority with political satire and street theater.
author: Richard Sandomir

title: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Hathaway Chairman
description: “Father Time always wins,” the 96-year-old, who turned Berkshire Hathaway into an investing powerhouse, said in a letter to shareholders. He will remain on the board as chairman emeritus.
author: Michael J. de la Merced

title: Trump Has Finally Lost the Plot
description: It is now apparent that many Americans — probably enough Americans — are determined to live within the truth rather than the lie.
author: Jonathan Rauch and Peter Wehner

title: Two Centuries On, Smithsonian Connects Jefferson’s Hair to Hemings’s Children
description: A new book describes how cutting-edge genomics techniques yielded “extraordinary proof” that Thomas Jefferson fathered children with Sally Hemings.
author: Jennifer Schuessler

title: How Trump Has Disrupted National Parks
description: Maintenance projects have been put off around the country and resources diverted to the president’s favored projects in Washington.
author: Maxine Joselow

title: Kennedy Center Supporters Rally Amid Fears of Trump’s Demolition
description: Photos of President Trump reviewing a poster board with the title “Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED” spurred the largest gathering yet in support of the performing arts institution.
author: Chris Cameron

title: Trump Says He Has Banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico From White House
description: The president cited reporting from the outlets that he deemed “fake news.” It was unclear how such a ban would be enforced or defended in court.
author: Michael M. Grynbaum and Benjamin Mullin

title: A Central African Hotel Has Become a Nightmare Prison for U.S. Deportees
description: Witnesses say men were hooded and beaten in Equatorial Guinea. The autocratic government there is a partner in President Trump’s deportation program.
author: Megha Rajagopalan and Pranav Baskar
